usedFor: ShipStation holds your orders, and Brevo keeps your email contacts when “New Order Created” runs “Add Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in ShipStation, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: Each new order adds the buyer to Brevo, or updates them if they already exist.

watchOut: “Add Contacts To List” only takes existing contacts, so run “Add Or Update Contact” first for new buyers.
